title: Chronological failover simulator and sampled KV checker with latency-budget enforcer
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Build a deterministic, chronological failover simulator and telemetry-replay harness to validate active-passive promotion procedures, progressive load-shedding policies, circuit-breaker hystereses, and backup/restore integrity. The simulator will replay real traffic traces, apply configured routing policies (primary -> passive promotion windows), exercise circuit breakers at route and node granularity, and run a sampled KV consistency checker after each simulated cutover. The goal is to: (1) surface SLO regressions tied to specific failover decisions, (2) validate restore semantics and snapshot replay correctness, and (3) quantify the operational window where graceful degradation policies keep tail latency within the latency budget. This ticket covers design, PoC harness, integration with Console telemetry, and two scheduled drills against a staging environment.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can ingest a 24h traffic trace and deterministically replay events with time-scaling and error injection
Configurable circuit-breaker profiles (route/node/global) are applied during replay and produce expected open/close timelines
Progressive load-shedding policies (priority buckets + token-based limiters) can be toggled and their impact on P50/P95/P99 latencies is measured
Sampled KV consistency checker validates snapshot rehydration at configurable sampling rates and reports bitwise diffs or key-level anomalies
End-to-end run produces a drill report with SLO deltas, rollback triggers, and remediation recommendations that can be imported into Console dashboards
Runbook playbook artifacts (operator checklist + scripted remediation steps) are committed and peer-reviewed
steps: Design: finalize simulator API, inputs (trace format), and failure injection primitives (latency spikes, partial region outage, tokenstore lag)
Telemetry: extend current ingestion pipeline to export compact, anonymized traces suitable for replay (see telemetry-schema draft)
Simulator PoC: implement time-accurate event replayer and policy engine that exercises routing + CB + load-shed rules
KV checker: implement sampled validator that can mount snapshots, run read-after-restore checks, and surface checksum mismatches
Integrate with Console: push drill metrics (SLO heatmap, circuit state timeline, key inconsistency samples) to a per-drill dashboard
Run drills: execute two staged drills in staging with increasing severity, capture operator timings, and iterate on runbook
Document: publish drill report, checklist, and retrospective with actionable fixes and onboard SRE on next steps
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with SRE and Runtime teams — agreed on trace schema and a minimal set of failure modes (region outage, tokenstore lag, network partition)
2026-02-27: PoC replayer completed — can replay anonymized traces at 10x real-time and inject latency spikes per route
2026-03-03: Implemented policy engine for route-level circuit breakers; discovered hysteresis tuning tradeoffs when applying global fallback vs route-specific fallbacks
2026-03-07: KV checker PoC can mount snapshot and run 1% sampled key reads; found two classes of eventual-consistency gaps in snapshot rehydration that require minor restore ordering changes
2026-03-10: Integrated basic metrics export into Console; preparing first staged drill for 2026-03-24. Operator checklist drafted and under review by oncall rotation lead
decisions: Use anonymized request traces (derived from production billing traces) rather than full payloads to keep replay light and privacy-safe
Favor route-level circuit-breaker hysteresis tuned to latency budgets instead of only global CB to reduce unnecessary fallbacks
Sampled KV checker will default to 0.5% read sampling in staging runs and escalate to 5% if discrepancies are observed
Simulator will run in deterministic mode for test-reproducibility and time-scaled mode for operator-run drills to shorten window
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Replay fidelity may not capture user-visible tail latencies — Mitigation: include synthetic high-latency spikes and validate against production percentiles
Risk: KV checker false positives from snapshot rotation — Mitigation: correlate with snapshot metadata and run CRC checks; add backoff when snapshot in-flight
Risk: Operator fatigue from noisy alerts during drills — Mitigation: funnel drill signals to a dedicated drill channel and disable customer-facing alerting during scheduled windows
runbook_summary: Operator checklist for the staged drill: (1) pre-check health and snapshot freshness; (2) put affected customer routes into maintenance; (3) run replay in dry-run mode and review SLO heatmap; (4) execute promotion in time-scaled mode while monitoring circuit states; (5) run sampled KV checker; (6) if SLO delta exceeds threshold, trigger automated rollback and run forensic snapshot comparison
retrospective_notes: Found two restore-ordering race conditions leading to temporary read-after-restore anomalies; proposed change to rehydrate index bucket before replicas
Circuit-breaker default hysteresis caused flapping in two low-traffic routes; plan to add traffic-weighted CB thresholds
Run time-scaled mode at 5x for operator rehearsals to reduce drill window without losing order fidelity
release_notes: Added chronological failover simulator (PoC) and KV sampled checker to runtime-1.19
New drill dashboard and exportable drill reports available in Console
Introduced default drill-maintenance mode to mute customer-facing alerts during scheduled runs
